title: Spicy Caramel Garlic Glazed Chicken
description: Sweet and spicy, this glaze is perfect for chicken. It adds a caramelized exterior and a kick of heat.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and chili.
Rub the garlic-chili mixture all over the chicken breasts.
Drizzle olive oil over the chicken.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
While the chicken is baking, heat the caramel sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Remove the chicken from the oven and brush the caramel sauce all over the top.
Return the chicken to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the caramel is bubbly and slightly caramelized.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
